events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Edge Building Services, Inc. Glendale, AZ. At 5:30 p.m. on September 23, 2017, an employee was refinishing tables and chairs that had graffiti on them. The employee was found face down and unresponsive by a security guard in a storage room and was taken by ambulance to a hospital for treatment. The employee was pronounced dead 12-days later of an intraparenchymal hemorrhage commonly referred to as a stroke. The incident was not work-related and was natural causes according to the Maricopa Medical Examiner.
